name: m10-01-3
title: From 4K video games to GPGPU and CUDA
spec:
timeline
    title NVIDIA Data Center GPU Evolution: Solving Each Era's Bottleneck
    Pre-2006 : Fixed-Function Graphics : Rigid Vertex & Pixel pipelines
    2006 : G80 & CUDA : Unified SMs + C code with __global__
    2012 : Kepler (K80) : Early Deep Learning : High-density FP32 & FP64 scalar CUDA cores
    2016 : Pascal (P100) : Memory & Interconnect : HBM2, Unified Memory, NVLink 1.0 (160 GB/s), native FP16
    2017 : Volta (V100) : The AI Pivot : 1st-Gen Tensor Core (4x4 matrix multiply-accumulate in 1 cycle)
    2020 : Ampere (A100) : Utilization & Scale : MIG (7 hardware slices), TF32, BF16, 2:4 Sparsity, NVLink 3 (600 GB/s)
    2022 : Hopper (H100/H200) : The LLM Era : Transformer Engine (dynamic FP8), HBM3/3e, NVLink 4 (900 GB/s)
    2024+ : Blackwell (B200/GB200) : Rack-Scale AI : 2nd-Gen Transformer Engine (FP4), NVLink 5 (1.8 TB/s), NVL72 (130 TB/s)

name: m10-01-5
title: Phase 1 (Prefill and TTFT) versus Phase 2 (Decode and TPOT)
spec:
sequenceDiagram participant Client as User Client participant Host as Host CPU Tokenizer participant TC as GPU Tensor Cores participant HBM as GPU HBM: Weights + KV Cache Client->>Host: POST 2,000-token prompt Host->>TC: Token IDs copied over PCIe (PREPROCESS_MS) Note over TC,HBM: PHASE 1: PREFILL (Compute-Bound)
Parallel GEMM over all 2,000 prompt tokens at once TC->>HBM: Write 2,000 Key & Value context vectors to KV Cache TC-->>Client: Emit Token 1 -> Measure TTFT (Time To First Token) loop PHASE 2: DECODE (Memory-Bandwidth-Bound, repeats per output token) HBM->>TC: Stream ALL model weights + entire KV Cache from HBM Note over TC: Compute attention & projection for 1 new token TC->>HBM: Append new token K/V vectors to KV Cache TC-->>Client: Emit next token -> Measure TPOT (Time Per Output Token) end
